prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Empire C01-SCENE-OLD-FLAG-HOMECOMING, a complete opaque 16:9 narrative illustration, target 1672 by 941 pixels.
Primary request: Old-banner soldiers coming home by their own choice. A small group of ordinary former Loen soldiers enters a modest timber-and-stone rural village. The central emotional action is a tired helmetless soldier in practical worn blue cloth and simple steel armor being welcomed by an older civilian at an open cottage gate. They meet each other's eyes and clasp forearms naturally at equal height, relieved and reserved rather than triumphant. A second returning soldier with a travel pack walks toward another waiting adult resident; a third companion has stopped beside a low fence with a round shield at rest. No named heroes are depicted.
Source meaning: After the old command banners fall, soldiers are allowed to choose their own destinations; one group goes home. Preserve dignity and voluntary return. This is everyday homecoming, not surrender, recruitment, military occupation, or a triumphal procession. The original slot is a village with old soldiers, modest cottages, paths, fences and trees. Rebuild its actual subject as a readable close narrative view rather than copying the tiny overhead map.
Input images: Image 1 is the accepted CH06-S29 style reference; Image 2 is the accepted CH04-S19 style reference; Image 3 is the accepted CH07-S36E style reference. These are STYLE references only. Do not copy their named people, ghosts, dragon, insignia, texts, or story props.
Style/medium: Match the references' chunky matte cartoon-fantasy painting. Strong clean dark silhouettes, broad simple color masses, 2 to 3 shadow values, simplified rounded faces, compact sturdy human proportions, generous readable hands, restrained material texture. Slightly raised eye-level narrative camera. No tiny stippling, scratched hatching, realistic microtexture, gloss, cinematic photorealism or isometric map-camera.
Composition: Wide single full scene, edge-to-edge opaque environment, no border or panel. Central returning soldier and welcoming older civilian stay together near the middle 40 percent of the frame, with faces and clasped forearms visible. They are large enough to read at 256 by 144. A simple open gate and cottage doorway behind them establish arrival home. Side companions and modest houses broaden the village context without competing. Simple overlapping broad trees and distant blue hills. Avoid filling the scene with crowds.
Color and mood: Clear soft daylight, blue cloth and slate armor against warm brown cottage beams, warm cream plaster, subdued green grass and a little autumn ochre foliage. Modest warmth and fatigue, not a perfect victory celebration.
Constraints: An old blue cloth standard may be rolled and tucked into a returning companion's pack, without any visible emblem. No invented heraldry, no crown, snowflake, star, sigil or faction badge. No character copied from reference. Weapons sheathed and shields lowered. No captors, chains, guards ordering civilians, kneeling, children in military service, banners of conquest, lettering, written text, numbers, watermark or UI. Do not add a dragon or magical effects. Finish all edges as an opaque background.
